definitions: To do something without a plan or prior experience, relying on instinct and improvisation.
To operate or proceed in an intuitive or extemporaneous way rather than by a set plan or rules.
examples: We had to fly by the seat of our pants when the original plan fell through.
She's always been one to fly by the seat of her pants, making decisions on the fly.
There was no manual, so he just had to fly by the seat of his pants to fix the machine.
lemma: fly by the seat of one's pants
source: fly by the seat of one's pants
